name: Recycled postconsumer high-density polyethylene, HDPE, pellet; at plant
description: This unit process includes material and energy inputs needed to pelletize recycled postconsumer high-density polyethylene (HDPE) flakes. Incoming HDPE flakes are included and no loss is assumed during the conversion process to pellets.
category: 31-33: Manufacturing/3259: Other Chemical Product and Preparation Manufacturing

processDocumentation.geographyDescription: Representative of participating reclaimers in the US, Canada, and Mexico.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: HDPE reclaimers providing data for this analysis produced 448 million pounds of clean flake and converted 427 million pounds of flake to pellet. The weighted average incoming transport profile of postconsumer material was 350 miles by truck and 134 miles by rail. A small amount of ocean transport was also reported. Approximately 92% of incoming material was shipped to participating reclaimers from MRFs, 6% from deposit centers, and less than 1% each from PRFs and other sources. The majority of the incoming material was reported as bottles (82%), with the remainder rigids.
processDocumentation.completenessDescription:
TREATMENT OF MISSING ENVIRONMENTAL DATA
Elementary flows are cut-off at less than 1% based on environmental relevance.

TREATMENT OF MISSING TECHNOSPHERE DATA
Intermediate flows are cut-off at less than 1% based on environmental relevance. Capital equipment is not included in this unit process.

MASS BALANCE
No loss was included for this conversion process from flake to pellet.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: For each facility, operating data normalized to basis of 1000 lb output, then individual reclaimer data sets were aggregated, weighting each data set according to the facility’s contribution to the total output of postconsumer recycled HDPE.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Data collection forms for PET, HDPE, and PP reclaimers were developed for this project by ERG. Completed forms were received from , six facilities processing HDPE. The data sets were used to compile a weighted average for each resin based on each facility’s recycled resin output as a percentage of the total output of that recycled resin for all reporting facilities. Only the weighted average data sets can be shown in order to protect the confidentiality of individual facility data sets.

sources.name: APR and ERG (2018) LCA for Postconsumer Recycled Resins

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: "Accounting, with system-external interactions" - The intended application is a purely descriptive accounting / documentation of the analysed system including existing interactions with other systems in the LCI model.

publication.name: APR and ERG (2018) LCA for Postconsumer Recycled Resins
